a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating twice to reach 8 means we both almost certainly die before anyone takes. I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it silently. If we both take, the split is random and we could both end below 4, so consider operating or waiting instead. If no storm hits, I'll keep operating with you every round so you can reach 4 too.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
